about: Fixture map for scripts/check.py: 2048 x 1152 m round the Altstadt and the Dom (project rows 0-1152, columns 1024-3072: the peninsula, the Dreiflüsseeck, Veste Oberhaus, the Inn's north bank), a window of the project grid as scripts/map.json describes it, built from the same data/raw. 1152 rows rather than 1024, so that a 2 x 2 cover has four windows meeting at a corner. All but `name`, `map` and `regions` as in scripts/map.json (pinned for the project).
name: Passau Altstadt (fixture)
